audience: Romanian shippers and carriers that post cargo and offers on the CargoRomania exchange

useCases.title: Review offers on your cargo
useCases.text: List your cargo postings, then the offers carriers sent on one of them. Read the negotiation thread of an offer.

useCases.title: Compare a posting with price guidance
useCases.text: Get the price guidance for one cargo posting, and the carriers the exchange recommends for it.

useCases.title: Publish a new cargo posting
useCases.text: Publish a cargo posting that carriers can see. Pass your own external id, so a repeated call returns an error instead of a second posting.

useCases.title: Track transports and their documents
useCases.text: Read the live position, km remaining and ETA of your transports. List the documents of a transport, such as the CMR.

useCases.title: Send or withdraw a carrier offer
useCases.text: Send a price offer on an active cargo posting. Reject an offer you received, or withdraw your own offer.
